# AstryxAspectRatio { #anylumino.AstryxAspectRatio }

```python
AstryxAspectRatio(children=None, *, ratio=16 / 9, **props)
```

Constrain child content to a fixed aspect ratio.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type         | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Default    |
|----------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| children | ChildInput   | Child widget, sequence of widgets, or mapping of slot names to widgets.                                                                                                                                                             | `None`     |
| ratio    | int \| float | Aspect ratio as a numeric width divided by height value.                                                                                                                                                                            | `'16 / 9'` |
| **props  | Any          | JSON-safe AspectRatio props. Useful keys: className and style. The ratio prop is set from the Python argument unless explicitly overridden in props. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/AspectRatio>. | `{}`       |
